scientific_integrity: Exact all-length Eulerian support proof with three independent finite/algebraic verification programs; no independent external validation or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Binary indexed cyclic words; ordered contiguous windows of length exactly three; noiseless complete profile observation; no linear-word or larger-alphabet assertion. The leading asymptotic coefficient 1/288 is known from Kiah-Puleo-Milenkovic; an expanded 2012 comparison paper was available only in abstract and requires independent priority review.
title: Exact generating function for cyclic binary trigram profiles
